title: The Fruit of Grisaia
provenance: Reported by Slendog (highball-db#483, 2026-10-14), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, Wine's own Direct3D (wined3d), recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 4 of 5 after 26 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: A visual novel, playable on Wine's own Direct3D on the default engine. The menus run smoothly, animations and picture transitions are a bit laggy.

knownIssues.symptom: Animations and picture transitions are a bit laggy
